description: Twelve original public synthetic helpdesk fixtures, separate from the sales browser schema and original sales evaluation fixtures. Held out from guided examples, not a sealed external benchmark. Reference execution is not model accuracy. Expected values were specified independently before reference execution.
seed: CREATE TABLE organizations(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT)
CREATE TABLE agents(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT)
CREATE TABLE tickets(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,organization_id INTEGER REFERENCES organizations(id),agent_id INTEGER REFERENCES agents(id),priority TEXT,status TEXT,hours REAL)

cases.question: Which ticket IDs are open, in ID order?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT id FROM tickets WHERE status='open' ORDER BY id

cases.question: Which ticket IDs have no assigned agent?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT id FROM tickets WHERE agent_id IS NULL ORDER BY id

cases.question: What is the average recorded effort in hours for closed tickets?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(hours) FROM tickets WHERE status='closed'

cases.question: Which organizations have no tickets?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.name FROM organizations o LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.organization_id=o.id WHERE t.id IS NULL

cases.question: Which agents have no assigned tickets?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT a.name FROM agents a LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.agent_id=a.id WHERE t.id IS NULL

cases.question: List each organization and its ticket count, including zero counts.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.name, COUNT(t.id) FROM organizations o LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.organization_id=o.id GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY o.name

cases.question: How many high-priority tickets are open?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets WHERE priority='high' AND status='open'

cases.question: Which tickets have recorded effort greater than four hours?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT id FROM tickets WHERE hours > 4 ORDER BY id

cases.question: List agent names assigned at least three tickets and their ticket counts.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT a.name, COUNT(*) FROM agents a JOIN tickets t ON t.agent_id=a.id GROUP BY a.id HAVING COUNT(*)>=3

cases.question: For each organization with tickets, return its name and ticket ID with the greatest recorded effort.
cases.reference_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT organization_id,id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY organization_id ORDER BY hours DESC,id) AS n FROM tickets) SELECT o.name,r.id FROM ranked r JOIN organizations o ON o.id=r.organization_id WHERE r.n=1 ORDER BY o.name

cases.question: List ticket IDs whose effort exceeds the average effort of closed tickets.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT id FROM tickets WHERE hours > (SELECT AVG(hours) FROM tickets WHERE status='closed') ORDER BY id
